caption: The drawing depicts a single, teardrop-shaped powder flask positioned vertically in the center of the image. The lower, rounded body of the flask is a brown leather or leather-like material with embossed decoration, featuring two birds in a grassy or marsh-like setting surrounded by a decorative border. Near the top of the flask, above the birds, there is a small embossed motif, possibly three small rounded objects. The neck of the flask is fitted with a metallic, brass or gold-colored dispenser cap and lever mechanism at the very top, used for pouring or measuring gunpowder. The outer edge of the flask shows stitched detailing. The background is a plain, off-white or cream color with no additional objects or scenery. The name "David P. Willoughby" is printed in small letters towards the bottom right of the image.
title: Powder Horn
